full_judgment: 9. Mr. Saifuddin Ahmed Chowdhury, learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that the Courts below after due consideration of averments made in the plaint, the evidence adduced by the parties and record of the settlement case having found that the settlement case in the name of the predecessor of the plaintiffs did not attain finally with the payment of entire amount of salami and the execution of kabuliyat, rightly held that by virtue of the settlement case, no title in respect of the suit property had been conferred upon the plaintiffs and as such High Court Division erred in law setting aside the judgment and decree of the Courts below without adverting to the land said concurrent findings. He further submitted that the High Court Division erred in law in misreading and misinterpretation of the observation made by the lower appellate Court that, “বাদীপক্ষের পূর্ববর্তী আ: মান্নানের নামে ভূমি বাবদ ১৫৭/৫০-৫১ নং গ্রুপ সেটেলমেন্ট কেস রুজু থাকায় এবং তিনি পরবর্তীতে সেলামীর টাকা পরিশোধ করার নিমিত্ত আবশ্যকীয় প্রতিকার প্রার্থনা যুক্তে বাদী পক্ষের আদালতের স্মরণাপন্ন হওয়া যুক্তিযুক্ত ও সংগত ছিল।” In as such as admittedly the settlement case having not been finally concluded with the payment of entire amount of salami and the execution of Kabuliyat with the establishment of land lord and tenant relationship, no title in respect of the suit property was conferred upon the plaintiffs and hence, they are not entitled to get any relief by way of declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in the suit property. He lastly submitted that the High Court Division erred in law in making the Rule absolute declaring title of the plaintiffs in the suit property who are admittedly out of possession inasmuch as a party out of possession cannot get any r decree for declaration of title without a decree for khas possession.
